q: You measure the voltage of a resistor on the range $2\,\text{V}$, and OL appears on the display. What does the reading mean, and what do you do?
a: OL means that the voltage is larger than the largest value of the range, $1.999\,\text{V}$. Next turn the selector to the larger range $20\,\text{V}$ and read the reading there.

q: A multimeter shows the reading $3.00\,\text{V}$ on the range $20\,\text{V}$. The error limit is $\pm(0.5\,\% + 2\ \text{digits})$ and the resolution $0.01\,\text{V}$. How large is the error limit?
